value.rationale: It solves a natural, fully parameterized finite parallel noisy-localization design and exhibits exact continuous transition from noiseless trisection to repeat-middle querying, with strict suboptimality of both at every intermediate noise. Unlike an arbitrary example, the optimum and risk are exact for the full mirror-symmetric two-query family and applicable to latency-constrained sensing.
